/assistants.note: The Assistants API was sunset on 2026-08-26 (deprecation announced 2025-08-26). Replacement: Responses API + Conversations API. Mapping: Assistants -> Prompts (dashboard), Threads -> Conversations, Runs -> Responses, Run steps -> Items. Reusable prompt objects are themselves deprecated (v1/prompts shuts down 2026-11-30), so prefer keeping instructions/tools in code.

/threads.note: Threads, runs and messages are part of the Assistants API, sunset 2026-08-26. Use the Conversations API (/conversations) with Responses (/responses). Thread history can no longer be read from the API; use messages your app stored.

/completions.note: Completions is a legacy endpoint (the model pages label it 'Completions (legacy)'). The instruct/base models it served (gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct, babbage-002, davinci-002) were shut down on 2026-09-28. Move prompt/completion calls to Responses (or Chat Completions).

/edits.note: /v1/edits and the edit models were shut down 2024-01-04; the deprecations page recommends /v1/chat/completions.

/engines.note: /v1/engines was replaced by /v1/models (shut down 2022-12-03). /v1/search, /v1/classifications and /v1/answers were shut down the same day.

/fine-tunes.note: The original /v1/fine-tunes API was replaced by /v1/fine_tuning/jobs.

/audio/translations.note: /v1/audio/translations shuts down 2027-02-26; recommended replacement is v1/realtime/translations. The spec marks createTranslation deprecated.

/audio/speech.note: All text-to-speech models (tts-1, tts-1-hd, gpt-4o-mini-tts snapshots) shut down 2027-01-06; recommended replacement is gpt-realtime-2.1-mini via the Realtime API.

/audio/transcriptions.note: whisper-1, gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe and gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize shut down 2027-02-26; replacements gpt-live-transcribe or gpt-transcribe.

/videos.note: The Videos API and Sora 2 models were removed on 2026-09-24 with no listed replacement.

/images/variations.note: The spec marks createImageVariation deprecated. Variations were a DALL-E feature; DALL-E 2/3 were shut down 2026-05-12.

/chat/completions.note: Chat Completions remains supported, but Responses is recommended for new projects. Starting with GPT-5.4, Chat Completions does not support tool calling with reasoning_effort other than none; GPT-6 Astra / 6.1 Sol / 6.1 Terra require Responses for tool calling.

/prompts.note: Reusable prompt objects and the v1/prompts API are scheduled to shut down 2026-11-30. Move prompt content into application code. Watch for `prompt: { id: ... }` in Responses requests.

/evals.note: Evals platform: read-only from 2026-10-31, dashboard and API shut down 2026-11-30.

functions.note: Deprecated in favor of `tools` (each entry becomes {type: 'function', function: {...}}).

max_tokens.note: Deprecated in favor of `max_completion_tokens` and not compatible with o-series / reasoning models.

user.note: Being replaced by `safety_identifier` (abuse detection; hash user ids) and `prompt_cache_key` (cache bucketing).

prompt_cache_retention.note: Deprecated; use `prompt_cache_options.ttl`. The GPT-6 guide says to replace it with prompt_cache_options.ttl set to "30m" when migrating from GPT-5.5 or earlier.

seed.note: The spec marks `seed` deprecated (Beta, best-effort determinism).

truncation.note: The spec marks `truncation` deprecated; check the Responses reference before relying on it.

prompt.note: Reusable prompt objects (v1/prompts) shut down 2026-11-30; inline the prompt content instead.

user.note: Deprecated: use `safety_identifier` (user still accepted as a fallback).

response_format.note: Legacy parameter for retired image models; unsupported for GPT image models, which always return base64.

style.note: Legacy parameter for retired image models; describe the style in the prompt for GPT image models.

response_format.note: Legacy parameter for retired image models; unsupported for GPT image models.

hyperparameters.note: Deprecated in favor of `method` (pass hyperparameters under method).

reasoningModels.note: When reasoning effort is not none, remove temperature, top_p and top_logprobs; for Chat Completions also remove logprobs; for Responses remove message.output_text.logprobs from include. GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol do not support effort none (use low). max_tokens is not compatible with o-series models; use max_completion_tokens (Chat) or max_output_tokens (Responses).

params.messages: input (a string or an array of input Items); system/developer messages can move to top-level `instructions`
params.tools: tools, but function definitions are internally tagged ({type:'function', name, parameters, strict}) instead of {type:'function', function:{...}}; omitting strict attempts strict mode in Responses
params.n: not available in Responses; make separate requests
params.store: store (Responses are stored by default; set store:false to opt out)
params.stream: stream, but events are typed SSE (e.g. response.output_text.delta) instead of chunks with choices[].delta
params.web_search_options: use the hosted web search tool in `tools`
params.audio: audio output is listed as coming soon for Responses on the migration page; check before migrating audio flows
params.modalities: not a Responses parameter; check the Responses reference

confidence.reasoning_effort: verified (reasoning guide names reasoning.effort for Responses vs reasoning_effort for Chat)
confidence.max_completion_tokens: verified that Responses uses max_output_tokens (reasoning guide); the 1:1 mapping is our reading
confidence.verbosity: verified that the Responses text param has format and verbosity (openapi ResponseTextParam)
confidence.logprobs: verified from the GPT-6 guide's include value; the exact mapping is our reading
confidence.web_search_options: our reading of the migration guide's hosted-tools section

chatToResponses.output: choices[0].message.content -> response.output_text (SDK helper) or iterate response.output Items by type; tool calls arrive as function_call Items and results go back as function_call_output Items with the matching call_id
chatToResponses.state: Multi-turn: previous_response_id (resend instructions each turn; prior tokens still billed), replay output Items manually, or the Conversations API
pitfalls: Reading choices[0].message.content instead of response.output_text / response.output
Treating every output entry as a message (reasoning and tool calls are separate Item types)
Dropping reasoning / function_call / function_call_output Items when carrying context manually
Sending a function result without the matching call_id
Reusing Chat Completions streaming chunk handlers
Assuming previous_response_id removes billing for prior context
